decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - No development shall take place until full details of hard and soft landscaping and means of enclosure of all un-built, open areas have been submitted to and approved by the Council. [Such details shall include details of any proposed earthworks including grading, mounding and other changes in ground levels.] 

Reason: To enable the Council to ensure a reasonable standard of visual amenity in the scheme in accordance with the requirements of policies [EN15 if landscape details], [EN61 if trees only] [and EN35 if in a CA] of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 2 - All hard and soft landscaping works shall be carried out to by not later than the end of the following planting season, with others of similar size and species, unless the Council gives written consent to any variation. a reasonable standard in accordance with the approved landscape details by not later than the end of the planting season following completion of the development or any phase of the development, whichever is the sooner. Any trees or areas of planting which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced as soon as is reasonably possible and, in any case,

Condition : 3 - A method statement in respect of the commissioning, form and
    location of the Public Art shall be submitted to and agreed
    by the Council before the open space is completed and
    occupied.

Condition : 4 - In order that the Council may give consideration to the
    details of the proposed development.

Condition : 5 - To ensure that the landscaping is carried out within a
    reasonable period and to maintain a satisfactory standard of
    visual amenity in the scheme.

Condition : 6 - In order that the Council may give consideration to the
    details of the proposed development.

Condition : 7 - The details required pursuant to additional conditions 1 & 3
    should be submitted with the attached approval of details
    application form together with 5 sets of drawings and any
    other supporting information.
description:
The provision of a new landscaped square between nos. 1 & 4
Triton square, the Euston Tower and 2 & 3 Triton Square
comprising both hard and soft landscaping,
as shown on drawing numbers 1946 SK/ 01 & 02 and RP TR1/
P01C, P02C, P03G & P05.
